meta.name: ai-rag-pipeline
meta.description: Build RAG (Retrieval Augmented Generation) pipelines with web search and LLMs. Tools: Tavily Search, Exa Search, Exa Answer, Claude, GPT-4, Gemini via OpenRouter. Capabilities: research, fact-checking, grounded responses, knowledge retrieval. Use for: AI agents, research assistants, fact-checkers, knowledge bases. Triggers: rag, retrieval augmented generation, grounded ai, search and answer, research agent, fact checking, knowledge retrieval, ai research, search + llm, web grounded, perplexity alternative, ai with sources, citation, research pipeline

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 组合网络搜索与AI，生成带来源的回答
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你想要AI的回答基于可靠来源而不只是猜测
copy.tagline_en: Search the web and use AI to answer with sources
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want AI answers grounded in reliable sources rather than guesses

howto.what: 装上后 Claude 会调用 Tavily、Exa 等搜索工具从网页找信息，再把结果交给 Claude、GPT-4 等模型生成带来源的回答；也能做事实核查、多源研究或生成研究报告。
howto.when: 当你提到 RAG、检索增强生成、搜索+LLM 等关键词，或要求联网检索后回答时触发。

say.text: 核查这句话：AI 将在 2030 年取代 50% 的工作。
say.note: 会搜索证据并给出真/假等判定。

say.text: 用 Exa 搜索电动汽车市场趋势，再写一份带引用的报告。
say.note: 会汇总多来源信息生成报告。

howto.what_en: After installing, Claude can use tools like Tavily and Exa to search the web, then pass results to models like Claude, GPT-4 to produce sourced answers, fact-checks, or research reports.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention RAG, retrieval augmented generation, search+LLM, etc., or ask for web-grounded responses with citations.

say_en.text: Search for latest AI developments in 2024 on Tavily, then summarize with sources.
say_en.note: It searches first, then answers with sources.

say_en.text: Fact-check this claim: AI will replace 50% of jobs by 2030.
say_en.note: It looks for evidence and gives a verdict.

say_en.text: Use Exa to search EV market trends and write a report with citations.
say_en.note: It aggregates multiple sources into a report.
